title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 57-60 (Chandravadana, Chandra, Chandrasahodari, Chaturbhuja)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 57 to 60: Chandravadana, Chandra, Chandrasahodari, Chaturbhuja, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 57 to 60 with meaning
caption: Names 57 to 60 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 57 to 60**: **Chandravadana, Chandra, Chandrasahodari, Chaturbhuja**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Chandravadana, Chandra, Chandrasahodari, Chaturbhuja.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Chandravadana** means **Moon-faced**. A calm, cool, luminous face like the full moon.
**Chandra** means **The Moon-like**. Sri Suktam also calls her Chandra: cool, bright and gladdening.
**Chandrasahodari** means **The Moon's sister**. Tradition says Lakshmi and the moon both came from the ocean of milk, so the moon is her brother.
**Chaturbhuja** means **Four-armed**. Two hands hold lotuses and two give blessings and wealth. The four arms stand for dharma, artha, kama and moksha.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
